notes: Annual report of the Board of Park Commissioners for the year ending June 30, 1912. Curated: the Pioneer Log Cabin.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: a Mother's Cottage near the Children's House (not today's Mother's Building), the Stadium's cinder path and straightaway, a bridle road from Fulton Street to the Main Drive at Seventh Avenue, Alta Plaza's upper grounds finished.

findings.description: The log cabin built at the request of the Pioneer Women was finished, with an old-fashioned fireplace and a long porch across the front; $1,939.62 more was spent on it that year, with work on its grounds and a lavatory beside it.

citation.label: Annual report of the Board of Park Commissioners of San Francisco for the year ending June 30, 1912, Improvements; disbursements

resolution.method: A named park, playground or park building placed on its Recreation and Park place page by the name and streets the annual report give.
